verdict.rationale: Reflect's API uses OAuth 2 with user-created credentials and PKCE, so an agent client can work without embedded secret keys. The OpenAPI spec defines two coarse scopes, read:graph and write:graph, which allow basic read-only versus write separation but not fine-grained least privilege. Missing for 10: fine-grained scopes (per-endpoint, per-graph or per-note), documented token revocation and expiry, agent-specific credential management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
